latest.title: Counted drip rates vary widely between paramedics
latest.finding: Overall inaccuracy ranged from -45.3% to +5.8%; imprecision was primarily human; 1 gtt/s targets more accurate than all others (absolute error 31.1% vs 48.5%); whole-number rates more accurate than fractional (40.7% vs 54.1%)

latest.title: Electrical capture uncommon in prehospital transcutaneous pacing
latest.finding: Electrical capture in 18/56 (32%); among capturers, complete capture occurred only 27.2% of pacing time; median SBP change +22 mmHg with capture vs 0 mmHg without (p=0.031); clinician-verbalised pulse coincided with electrical capture in only 4/26 (15%) instances

latest.title: Military prehospital transfusion often outside guideline criteria
latest.finding: Meeting transfusion criteria was associated with requiring transfusion (RR 3.20, 95% CI 2.29–4.47); 65% of transfused patients did not meet criteria; median transfusion rate 25 mL/min
